strategy.overview: Star Wars turns the lit STAR WARS targets, upper passages, Fire Laser, and Cyclotron into an attack on enemy ships. Complete A-B-C to activate Cyclotron and raise Bonus X; shoot the upper loop to activate Fire Laser. Completing S-T-A-R twice lights Extra Ball at the upper loop. Completing W-A-R-S four times in one ball lights Special at Fire Laser, while destroying the enemy ships twice lights Special at the side rollovers.
strategy.simpleOverview: Complete A-B-C to activate Cyclotron and raise Bonus X, then shoot the lit STAR WARS attack targets and use Cyclotron to finish any surviving enemy ships. Complete S-T-A-R twice and shoot the upper loop for Extra Ball; complete W-A-R-S four times in one ball to light Fire Laser Special.
strategy.summary: Build A-B-C early so Cyclotron can finish an incomplete attack. When S-T-A-R is close, preserve that progress and take the upper-loop Extra Ball before chasing the longer W-A-R-S Special.

quickInfo.name: Extra Ball
quickInfo.summary: Complete S-T-A-R twice, then shoot the upper loop.

quickInfo.name: Fire Laser Special
quickInfo.summary: Complete W-A-R-S four times in one ball.

steps.text: Complete A-B-C to activate Cyclotron and raise the end-of-ball Bonus X.
Shoot whichever STAR WARS targets, upper passages, Fire Laser, or Cyclotron shots are lit during the enemy-ship attack.
Use Cyclotron to complete the destruction when an attack ends with enemy ships still remaining.
Complete S-T-A-R twice, then shoot the upper loop while Extra Ball is lit.

alternatives.title: Special route
alternatives.when: Use this when W-A-R-S is already advancing cleanly within the current ball.

steps.text: Complete W-A-R-S four times before the ball ends.
Hit Fire Laser while Special is lit; destroying the enemy ships twice also lights Special at the side rollovers.
Activate Cyclotron with A-B-C and keep taking the currently lit attack features.
Finish two complete enemy-ship destructions to light Special at the side rollovers.

machineSetup: Test the A-B-C targets, S-T-A-R and W-A-R-S target groups, upper loop, Fire Laser target, Cyclotron, upper passages, and both side rollovers.
Confirm that the attack lamps step visibly, Cyclotron completes remaining ships, and the installed Extra Ball and Special settings match the displayed inserts.

techniques.name: Dead Bounce
techniques.instruction: Let a predictable upper-loop return cross to the opposite flipper before aiming a letter target or Cyclotron again.

cautions.issue: W-A-R-S Special requires four completions during one ball.
cautions.response: Do not abandon a nearly finished S-T-A-R Extra Ball route for it unless W-A-R-S is already well advanced.
